# Fabrix

> > Fabrix™ manufactures acoustically transparent stretch fabric panel systems with precision track solutions for walls and ceilings.

Fabrix specializes in modular acoustic fabric systems designed for sound absorption and control in commercial and residential spaces. The company offers three primary track systems (Mid Load, Edge Load, and Corner Load) with multiple edge profile options, complemented by comprehensive installation guidance and sustainability commitments.

## Key Topics

- Acoustic fabric panels
- Stretch fabric systems
- Sound absorption
- Mid Load track system
- Edge Load track system
- Corner Load track system
- Edge Snap track system
- Fabric termination
- Installation guide
- Acoustic performance
- ASTM C423-09a
- RT60 measurement
- Eco-friendly materials
- Low VOC
- Warranty coverage

## Core Products & Systems

- [Fabrix™ Products Overview](https://fabrix.com/products): Complete product catalog including Mid Load, Edge Load, Corner Load, and Edge Snap systems for acoustic fabric installations.
- [Mid Load Track System](https://fabrix.com/mid-load): Fabrix™ Mid Load track system for secure stretch fabric panel installations with multiple edge profile options.
- [Edge Load Track System](https://fabrix.com/edge-load): Fabrix™ Edge Load track system for fabric walls and ceilings with anti-warp features and precision fabric control.
- [Corner Load Track System](https://fabrix.com/corner-load): Fabrix™ Corner Load track system for tight fabric seams at edges and corners with seamless transitions.
- [Edge Snap Track System](https://fabrix.com/edge-snap): Fabrix™ Edge Snap track system for secure stretch fabric wall and ceiling panels with quick installation.

## Track Specifications & Profiles

- [Mid Load Square Edge](https://fabrix.com/mid-load-square-edge): Mid Load Square Edge specifications (ML-15S, ML-27S, ML-53S) with anti-slip features for sharp terminations.
- [Mid Load Bevel Edge](https://fabrix.com/mid-load-bevel-edge): Mid Load Bevel Edge profile (ML-15B, ML-27B, ML-53B) for smooth fabric transitions and aesthetic finishes.
- [Mid Load Round Edge](https://fabrix.com/mid-load-round-edge): Mid Load Round Edge (ML-15R, ML-27R, ML-53R) for curved acoustic transitions and rounded installations.
- [Edge Load Square Edge](https://fabrix.com/edge-load-square-edge): Edge Load Square Edge specifications (EL-15S, EL-27S, EL-53S) for sharp acoustic panel terminations.
- [Edge Load Bevel Edge](https://fabrix.com/edge-load-bevel-edge): Edge Load Bevel Edge (EL-15B, EL-27B, EL-53B) with sloped profile transitions for seamless installations.
- [Edge Load Round Edge](https://fabrix.com/edge-load-round-edge): Edge Load Round Edge (EL-15R, EL-27R, EL-53R) for seamless curved transitions and modern aesthetics.
- [Corner Load Square Edge](https://fabrix.com/corner-load-square-edge): Corner Load Square Edge (CL-15S, CL-27S, CL-53S) for precise corner joins and tight fabric seams.
- [Corner Load Bevel Edge](https://fabrix.com/corner-load-bevel-edge): Corner Load Bevel Edge (CL-15B, CL-27B, CL-53B) with smooth corner transitions and professional finishes.
- [Corner Load Round Edge](https://fabrix.com/corner-load-round-edge): Corner Load Round Edge (CL-15R, CL-27R) for seamless curved corner installations and rounded edges.
